caption: A chat in Claude Desktop leaves a message for Codex Desktop through cmux, and Codex reads it from its inbox.

args.name: Bridge
args.command:
export ACPMUX_HOME=/tmp/bridge-demo; mkdir -p $ACPMUX_HOME; printf '\033]2;Bridge\007\033[H\033[2J'; sleep 3; printf '$ acpmux bridge send codex-desktop "Can you review the login fix?"
'; acpmux bridge send --from 'Claude Desktop' codex-desktop 'Can you review the login fix?'; sleep 2; printf '
$ acpmux bridge inbox codex-desktop
'; acpmux bridge inbox codex-desktop; exec sleep 86400
